data.name: VSM_001
data.value: This mist is getting thicker...[pause=10] I can barely see anything.

data.name: VSM_002
data.value: Hey, [player]...[pause=10] Does it feel like we're being watched?

data.name: VSM_005
data.value: A Pokémon just burst out of the ground!

data.name: VSM_006
data.value: And that one...[pause=15] it was waiting for us.

data.name: VSM_009
data.value: It doesn't matter.[pause=20] These creatures will not let you pass without a fight.

data.name: VSM_010
data.value: Show them your resolve...[pause=20] or perish.

data.name: VSM_012
data.value: They're still here...[pause=15] We're not losing this time!

data.name: VSM_013
data.value: We did it![pause=10] Those two were tough...

data.name: VSM_014
data.value: But that voice...[pause=15] Who was that?

data.name: VSM_015
data.value: I don't know.[pause=20] Let's keep moving.

data.name: VSM_016
data.value: They disappeared...[pause=15] Come on, let's continue the mission.

data.name: VSM_018
data.value: But you will rise again.[pause=30] They always do.
